newsitem.title: CHINA: JET AIR SAYS ACQUIRES WHISKY DISTRIBUTION.
newsitem.headline: JET AIR SAYS ACQUIRES WHISKY DISTRIBUTION.

text.p: Jet Air International Group Ltd said on Wednesday it had acquired the Far Eastern sole distribution for Highland Regal Whiskies.
The business was expected to generate US$30 million for Jet Air and Highland Regal in the coming three years, the company said in a statement.

The liquor distribution business was a new venture to the group's existing freight forwarding business, and would assist the firm to diversify the scope of its business and widen its earnings base, Jet Air said.
Jet Air would also be responsible for freight handling and transportation of Highland Regal from Scotland to 19 countries in Asia, it said.
